title: Building data for the fire resistance
description: Woodcore-Datei/building.json -- the building's data VKF / AEAI 15-15 (3.7.1, tables 1 to 3) reads the fire resistance of its load-bearing structure off, one file for the project, written by Woodcore's «Résistance au feu» tab and read by calc/domains/member_check.py at the export (issue #46). Each field is one of the ids calc/norms/vkf-2015-15-15-tab01-03-tragwerk.json lists, which calc/norms/vkf.py check_building holds it against. Absent, a check in the fire situation states its own duration or cannot be calculated; malformed, it stops the export naming the field.

height.description: The height category: low (up to 11 m, table 1), medium (up to 30 m, table 2), high (up to 100 m, table 3).

use.description: The use («Affectation»): housing, office, school, retail, parking, industry_low, agriculture, industry_high, lodging_a, lodging_b, lodging_c, assembly, department_store.

storeys.description: single (one storey: notes [1], [9]), two_small (two storeys, at most 2400 m² above ground: note [5]), several.
